independentCrossChecks: libDaltonLens.c Brettel/Viénot protan constants (plane1/plane2/separation normal, Viénot matrix) agree with ColorAdapt derivation to 5 decimals (M2.R1)
Machado 2009 Table 1 parsed from the authors' page equals the DaltonLens-Python table (< 1e-6)
assumptions: Machado 2009 matrices are applied to LINEAR RGB (ENGINEERING CONVENTION, M2.R1 primary review = category D: neither the paper nor the authors' page states the encoding and no official code exists; Eqs. 8-10 derive the matrices by integrating RGB-primary spectral power distributions, which implies linear-light RGB but is not an explicit statement)
Machado vectors only at tabulated severities (reference interpolation is buggy)
notes: linearOut: unclamped linear-RGB output of the reference simulator (float64).
srgbOut: clamp to [0,1] and sRGB-encode the above in float (reference formula).
srgb8Out: DaltonLens public simulate_cvd() 8-bit output (float32 pipeline), for +-1 level cross-check.
Inputs are 8-bit sRGB values divided by 255.
